notes.title: The Coin System
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It has recently been brought to our attention that the coin system in our game is not functioning properly. We are currently working on a new build/fix for this, as we speak!  We apologize for this inconvenience, as we aim to please!  Thanks for you patience, and (hopefully) your understanding.

Cheers,
DF Team!

notes.title: Dirty Fighter 2 is out!
notes.content:
Yo,

Dirty Fighter 2 has been officially released!  Let us know your thoughts, and please report any bugs!  We hope you have as good of time playing this game as we had making it!  If you have any recommendations for a third game, give us the deets.  

If you would like, please help us understand what you like (or dislike) about the Dirty Fighter Games by taking this short survey.

https://goo.gl/forms/ONYkz2QyPsO0jXQV2

Cheers,
DF Team!
